GRN-02 leverages cloud solutions to minimize the carbon footprint. GRN-03 promotes digital processes, significantly reducing paper usage. GRN-04 tracks resource impacts for continuous improvement. GRN-05 provides users visibility into their sustainability metrics. GRN-06 empowers users to offset carbon emissions, enhancing corporate responsibility. transcript.statement: Trustworthiness is paramount in a bookkeeping system. TRU-01 ensures encryption of sensitive financial data, safeguarding it from unauthorized access. TRU-02 establishes role-based access control, which is essential for protecting data integrity by ensuring only authorized personnel can modify transactions. TRU-03 mandates an immutable audit trail for accountability, while TRU-04 prevents malicious data entry. TRU-05 enhances security through two-factor authentication. TRU-06 ensures all user access is logged for transparency, and TRU-07 restricts data access to relevant accounts. Together, these requirements create a robust security framework essential for trust in financial systems.

transcript.statement: Ethical and compliance considerations are vital for a trustworthy bookkeeping system. RES-01 ensures adherence to financial regulations, guaranteeing legal accountability. RES-02 implements user access controls, crucial for preventing unauthorized modifications. RES-03 logs transactions with timestamps, enhancing transparency. RES-04 detects discrepancies, promoting user vigilance against fraud. RES-05 supports fair reporting in line with accounting standards. RES-06 allows for confidential reporting of ethical concerns, fostering a responsible culture. RES-07 guarantees multi-currency support with transparent rates, ensuring fairness in transactions. Together, these requirements uphold ethical practices and compliance, essential for user trust.

transcript.statement: Safety and reliability are paramount in a bookkeeping system to prevent data loss and ensure integrity. Each requirement is essential to maintain user trust and system reliability.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are processed within 2 seconds while integrating energy-efficient algorithms.
The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 100 users to ensure adequate throughput.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing by using efficient algorithms and data structures.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 transactions.
The system shall implement caching for frequently accessed data to reduce latency by at least 50%.
The system shall ensure that currency conversion operations complete within 3 seconds for real-time transactions.
The system shall maintain an immutable audit trail of all transactions for a minimum of 5 years.
The system shall implement user access controls incorporating ethical considerations.
The system shall provide functionalities to detect and alert users about potential financial discrepancies or fraud.
The system shall provide users with sustainability reports showing energy and resource consumption metrics.
The system shall ensure compliance with applicable financial regulations and standards.
The system shall validate currency conversions to ensure accuracy and prevent financial discrepancies.
The system shall ensure that all financial transactions are encrypted during transmission and storage.
The system shall implement error handling mechanisms to manage and recover from faults during transaction processing.

conflict_resolutions.rationale: Integrating energy-efficient processing within speed constraints ensures both safety and efficiency.

Combining sustainability reporting with security protocols ensures ethical oversight.
